scope: Stop one native stage contributor through the configured callback while an ordered answer streams; observe the requester report, ownership settlement, absence of continuation and an explicit retry after capacity returns.
prompt: Count from 1 to 40 in order, one integer per line. No commentary.
expectedLossLabel: A computer disconnected. Retry this answer.
reviewCriteria: The retried answer completes the requested count; correctness of the count is reviewed separately from lifecycle acceptance.
The requester-visible report states that a contributor was lost, not only that the answer could not finish.

codeReferences.acceptedLossCodes: packages/reploid/src/transport/partition-errors.json (CONNECTION_LOST is the only category that reports a disconnected contributor)
